global_rules: One active implementation owner per task or bug ID.
Adjacent discoveries are triaged instead of silently added to scope.
Status advances only when the required evidence exists.
Repository-backed WORK_QUEUE and BUGS sections are durable truth; PROJECT_STATE is generated.
Persistence, survivor identity, lifecycle ownership, save migration, or cross-system architecture work escalates to Codex.
Codex/Astra is the primary technical authority for assigned heavy engineering; OpenCode is the technical authority for assigned budget/scoped engineering.
ModForge/Boss/Planner coordinate scope, priority, constraints and evidence; they do not compete with the active implementation owner inside an approved work item.
Debug/console logs are on-demand evidence only; do not preload or continuously ingest them.
Raw game-design inspiration/reference material enters through Design Inbox and is not implementation authority until the owner promotes it through design review.
ModForge source writes are blocked by default; owner-approved ModForge writes must be recorded in the Change Ledger and reviewed by Codex/OpenCode before related implementation continues.
